feeds.title: CityScene Magazine » Food+Drink
feeds.description: CityScene Magazine offers delicious food and drinks content, tips, and tricks. Since starting its flagship publication, CityScene Magazine, in 1999, CityScene Media Group has been dedicated to producing high-quality publications with compelling content. They work with area arts organizations, Chambers of Commerce and leading event organizers to produce event guides, chamber directories, visitors' guides and other professional publications.

feeds.title: Hummusapien
feeds.description: Alexis Joseph is a food writer, blogger, Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN), toddler mama, and Co-Founder of the restaurant group Alchemy Brands. Hummusapien is a multifaceted food, wellness, travel, and lifestyle brand created in order to inspire others to eat and live fully delish! She uses her passion for cooking and wellness as fuel to help others ignite a more freeing relationship with food. The blog is brimming with nourishing (always delish!) recipes from a Registered Dietitian plus lifestyle tidbits to inspire you to live your most joyful, balanced life.

feeds.title: NeighborFood Blog » Sandwiches and Burgers
feeds.description: Courtney and Will are the authors, recipe developers, videographers, and food photographers behind the blog. They are also parents to two boys and ice cream connoisseurs. Featuring family friendly recipes for every meal of the day. They believe in the power of food to bring people together. Whether you're wondering what to make for dinner or the next family reunion, they have got you covered with fun and easy recipes.

feeds.title: 614NOW Magazine » Food & Drink
feeds.description: Explore the blog for food and drink articles, news, restaurants, and more. 614NOW is a magazine that covers a range of topics including food, drink, guides, hot topics, and more.

feeds.title: The Spiffy Cookie Blog
feeds.description: The Spiffy Cookie is a food blog authored by Erin. On this blog of hers you will find a diverse array of recipes: sweet and savory, healthy and sinful, simple and creative (the occasional craft or non-food post as well). She likes to put on a slightly healthier edge when possible, but sometimes she just has to listen to her inner fat-kid and stuff delicious things into cookies, cupcakes, burgers, pizza crusts, etc.

feeds.title: The Beard And The Baker
feeds.description: Hannah is the voice behind The Beard and The Baker. Joel, her husband, is the brains behind most of the awesome cooking you see here. Hannah is more of a baker and she doesn't have a beard. Hence, The Beard and The Baker. They create easy recipes that the entire family will love, provide travel tips, and restaurant reviews. They work with food, talk about food and fell in love over food. What started as a website to share their homemade recipes with you all has developed into a food-focused recipe, travel, review and event website and they love it that way.

feeds.title: Breakfast with Nick
feeds.description: Nick Dekker is the one you call 'Dr. Breakfast.' He is a breakfast blogger, author, and tour guide. With his wife and their two boys, they chase down breakfast everywhere they go. You'll also find him writing about coffee, brunch, donuts, beer, bourbon, travel, the arts, and our amazing city of Columbus, Ohio. Explore food, drink, travel, family fun, the arts, and much more with him.

feeds.title: CBUStoday » Food
feeds.description: The blog provides delicious food content that reader can much on while reading. CBUStoday is a subsidiary of 6AM. 6AM City is a hyper-local media company, focused on activating communities through daily email newsletters that aggregate the most positive, impactful local news + events.

feeds.title: The Lean Green Bean
feeds.description: Lindsay is a mom of three and Registered Dietitian from Columbus, OH. She loves sharing her passion for nutrition and healthy living with her readers! On this blog, you'll find healthy recipes, nutrition information, parenting tips, food prep tips and more! Her goal is to show you that healthy living doesn't have to be complicated or expensive.

feeds.title: Refectory Restaurant Blog
feeds.description: Keep up to date with the Refectory Restaurant Blog, see stories about our accomplishments, who we are, and the people that make it all possible.

feeds.title: The LocaL Magazine » Food & Drink
feeds.description: Discover ART - MUSIC - FOOD - FUN

feeds.title: Bread & Lettuce
feeds.description: Bread & Lettuce is a food blog authored by Alexandra. She has been vegan since 2012 and have more recently recommitted to a more whole-foods forward plant-based lifestyle since becoming a certified Food For Life instructor two years ago. She is passionate about healthy living; sustainable, local food; and discovering new cultures and community through cooking. Whether it is an ingredient, a cooking method, or cultural food tradition, she continues to be fascinated and inspired by food from around the world. You will find more about her discoveries on the blog.

feeds.title: Columbus Bites & Booze Blog
feeds.description: Jenny is the woman behind JENNY'S BITES & BOOZE Blog. She lives for experiences, exploring new cities, culture, food, drinks, and views. It just happens that bites & booze are consumed daily (okay ideally not daily on the booze in honor of health) and can always be made into an experience - whether prepared at home or out to eat at the coolest restaurant. She experienced a whole new world of food. She posts about her travels and food on her blog.

feeds.title: This is my take Blog
feeds.description: Daniel Moroyoui is a 39 year old, happily married, Mexican guy living in Columbus, Ohio. This is his take is a Food Blog founded in 2014 that focuses on easy to prepare healthy-ish recipes. He shares his take on some of his favorite dishes but with an interesting and pleasant healthy twist.

feeds.title: Crave Columbus Blog
feeds.description: Crave Columbus aims for different types of cuisines around the city. If you are looking for places to satisfy your taste buds in and around Columbus, then you have come to the right place. The blog offers delicious food articles, places to discover, variety of food, and more.

feeds.title: Columbus Food Adventures Blog
feeds.description: Local restaurant and foodie news updates and information from the founders of Columbus Food Adventures

feeds.title: The Kitchen Light
feeds.description: Delicious recipes for everything from a quick and easy dinner to fun snacks and desserts. Flexible and simple to edit for different tastes and dietary needs (especially gluten-free). Transform your kitchen weariness into joy!

feeds.title: Sophisticated Living Magazine » Food & Wine
feeds.description: Sophisticated Living

feeds.title: WhatNow Columbus
feeds.description: What Now Columbus is the premier news source for everything related to restaurants, retail, and real estate in the Columbus area. Learn what's trending in COLS today!

feeds.title: CookinGenie Blog » Columbus
feeds.description: CookinGenie is the solution for anyone looking for a gourmet quality meal, prepared fresh in their own kitchen and served hot on their table. They have a team of experienced chefs offering a variety of quality cuisines such as regional, French, Japanese, Chinese, Italian, Greek, and more. They realized how many of them found it difficult to plan and put fresh healthy meals on the dinner table every week. The blog provides interesting articles, places to discover, restaurants, and more.
